title: The Student Who Broke the Early Internet #Shorts

hook.narration: In nineteen eighty-eight, one student's experiment slowed down the early internet.

visuals.prompt: A 1980s university computer lab at night, green terminal screens glowing, code rippling across every monitor

scenes.narration: A Cornell graduate student, Robert Morris, released a program meant to quietly spread from computer to computer.

visuals.prompt: A young 1980s graduate student typing at a beige terminal in a dark lab, green text reflected on his glasses
A map of connected university computers drawn as glowing nodes, 1988 aesthetic

scenes.narration: A flaw made it copy itself again and again, clogging machines until they crawled.

visuals.prompt: A 1980s minicomputer with its cooling fans spinning hard and a screen flooded with repeating process lines
Network nodes turning red one by one across a dark map

scenes.narration: An estimated ten percent of the internet's computers were hit.

visuals.sub: of the early internet affected, by common estimates

scenes.narration: Morris became the first person convicted under the US Computer Fraud and Abuse Act.

visuals.prompt: A 1990 American courthouse exterior with stone columns at dusk, a lone figure climbing the steps

description: The Morris Worm of 1988 was one of the first major internet attacks, and it began as an experiment. #Shorts #History #Cybersecurity

thumbnail.prompt: A glowing green terminal with code spreading like a virus across a dark 1980s computer lab
